# orca project

Every `orca project` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca project list`

the registered projects: key, kind, control repository id, and root (a multi's member projects)

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).

## `orca project show`

the project's workspace mode and integration settings (and their revision)

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).

## `orca project set-workspace-mode --mode <mode>`

worktree or clone for the project's runs

- What it does: sends control verb `set-workspace-mode`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--mode <mode>` (required): worktree|clone

## `orca project set-integration --delivery <delivery> [--trigger <trigger>] [--method <method>] [--target <target>] [--remote <remote>]`

where the project's finished work goes by default

- What it does: sends control verb `set-integration-scheme`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--delivery <delivery>` (required): keep|local|push-target|push-branch|github-pr (anything but keep needs a person token)
- `--trigger <trigger>`: task|group
- `--method <method>`: merge|squash
- `--target <target>`: the target branch
- `--remote <remote>`: the remote

## `orca project set-criteria-review [--on] [--off]`

whether Orca's reviewer judges a flagged test change before a person sees it

- What it does: sends control verb `set-criteria-review`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--on`: switch it on
- `--off`: switch it off

## `orca project register-plan <path>`

register (or re-trust) a git-tracked plan file of the project so it can be imported

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<path>`: the plan file, relative to cwd or absolute

```
orca project register-plan docs/plans/next.json
```

## `orca project add <name> [--path <path>] [--dirs <dirs>]`

register a project: a git repository's root (--path) or a multi project of registered ones (--dirs); an owner's act

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca auth login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<name>`: the project's display name
- `--path <path>`: the repository's top-level directory (relative to cwd or absolute)
- `--dirs <dirs>`: a multi project's member project ids, comma-separated, in order

```
orca project add Web --path ~/code/web --as-person
orca project add Shop --dirs web,api --as-person
```
